title: Decision plain-push-asks cites an "owner answer A" that was a coordinator pick
why: docs/decisions/plain-push-asks.md lines 11 and 60 say "owner answer A, 2026-11-11 09:12 CST". At 09:12 CST the owner delegated, and the coordinator picked A (relayed at 09:14 CST). A wrong source makes a coordinator pick read as an owner ruling, and the past-ruling checks lean on that.
note: Fix: a one-line source edit at each of the two places: "owner delegated 2026-11-11 09:12 CST; coordinator pick A, relayed 09:14 CST". Prose only, express under R55; ruled prose path if a store entry backs it.
